title: Quantifying the dimensionality of multiparticle entanglement via partition rank
summary: The usefulness of entanglement as a resource in quantum technologies increases for larger systems, that is, if more particles or higher-dimensional quantum systems are considered. Yet, the interplay between dimensionality and multiparticle entanglement is not well understood. Only for two-particle systems an unambiguous and coherent notion of entanglement dimensionality, based on the Schmidt decomposition, is known.
